hero.subtitle: Install the extension, sign in, and your Chrome, Edge, and Firefox bookmarks become one tree. Keep organizing the way you always have — the sync engine handles the rest.

pain.title: The real pains of bookmark management
pain.subtitle: Your bookmarks are scattered everywhere — once lost, duplicated, or scrambled, they're hard to get back.

lost.title: Bookmarks silently disappear
lost.desc: Mistakes, browser crashes, sync failures — years of curated links gone in a flash.

crossBrowser.title: Browsers don't talk to each other
crossBrowser.desc: Chrome, Edge, and Firefox each keep their own set, and the same bookmarks never line up across them.

migration.title: One reorganization scrambles everything
migration.desc: Rename, move, or merge a folder and children often vanish or the hierarchy turns into a mess — fixing it is a nightmare.

history.title: Deletes resurrect and edits overwrite
history.desc: A bookmark you deleted on computer A comes back; two devices edit at once and one side silently overwrites the other.

features.title: An engine built for real sync scenarios
features.subtitle: More than a cloud backup — intelligent sync that actually preserves your bookmark structure.

sync.title: True tree structure, hierarchy never breaks
sync.desc: Sync keeps the tree as-is instead of flattening it into path strings. Rename, move, or reorder folders and every child and level is preserved — no more "renamed a folder and its children vanished".

history.title: Precise deletes, they never come back
history.desc: Deletes propagate across devices via tombstones. A bookmark removed on device A will never resurrect on device B from stale data.

quota.title: Tiered by count, only for capacity
quota.desc: Start with 500 free, 10,000 on Plus, unlimited on Pro. All tiers share identical sync features — upgrade purely for headroom.

privacy.title: Content encryption, your choice
privacy.desc: Plaintext by default and ready out of the box; privacy-sensitive users can enable optional end-to-end encryption so bookmarks are encrypted on your device before upload — even the server can't read them.

conflict.title: Automatic merge, nothing overwritten
conflict.desc: Two devices editing, deleting, and adding at once are reconciled by intelligent three-way merge — both sides' additions survive, nothing is blindly overwritten or lost. Offline edits merge in the moment you reconnect.

migration.title: Free cross-account migration
migration.desc: Sign in to any account to pull the full bookmark tree. New devices and new accounts initialize in seconds — no HTML exports, no manual cleanup.

browsers.title: Works with major browsers
browsers.subtitle: Install once — one setup unlocks all your bookmarks in the browsers you use daily.

pricing.title: Identical sync on every tier, pay only for capacity
pricing.subtitle: Free covers 500 bookmarks; Plus and Pro are yearly subscriptions for more. Whichever tier you choose, you get the full set of true-tree sync, precise deletes, and multi-device merging.

upgrade.q: Do the tiers differ in features?
upgrade.a: No. All three tiers have identical sync capabilities — cross-browser sync, multi-device consistency, precise delete sync and more. The only difference is the bookmark limit. You upgrade purely for more headroom.

refund.a: No-questions-asked refund within 7 days of your first subscription. Beyond that, refunds are available for serious technical issues. See Terms of Service Section 4 for details.

freeLimit.q: How many bookmarks does each tier hold?
freeLimit.a: Free holds up to 500, Plus up to 10,000, and Pro is unlimited. We count bookmarks rather than storage because a single bookmark is only about 200 bytes — counting is far more intuitive.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Via Creem we support Visa / Mastercard / Alipay / WeChat Pay and other major channels.

subOrOnetime.q: Why a subscription instead of a one-time purchase?
subOrOnetime.a: Sync continuously consumes server and bandwidth resources. A subscription keeps revenue aligned with cost and lets us maintain the service long term. Plus is $20/yr and Pro is $50/yr, cancel anytime, and you keep access until the end of the current billing period.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how BookmarkSync collects, stores, and uses your data.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only the minimum data needed to run the service: email address (for sign-in), browser bookmarks (for sync). We do not collect browsing history, do not track usage behavior, and do not embed third-party analytics.

store.title: How data is stored
store.body: All bookmark data is stored in Supabase (a PostgreSQL-based BaaS) with row-level security (RLS) enabled — each user can only read and write their own data. Login credentials are managed by Supabase Auth; we do not store plaintext passwords.

use.title: How data is used
use.body: Bookmark data is used solely for cross-browser sync. It will never be used for ads, marketing, user profiling, or any commercial analytics.

share.title: Do we share with third parties
share.body: No. We do not sell, rent, or trade any of your data. Payment is processed by Creem — we only receive payment success notifications, never your card details.

delete.title: How to delete data
delete.body: You can delete all bookmark data with one click in the extension options page. To delete your account, contact support — we will process it within 7 days.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For any questions about this policy, contact support{'@'}bookmarksync.app.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to BookmarkSync. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the BookmarkSync browser extension, website, and related services (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you confirm you have read and agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

service.title: 1. Service description
service.body: BookmarkSync is a cross-browser bookmark cloud sync and backup tool. It supports bookmark synchronization across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, with true-tree sync — renaming or moving folders never loses children — plus precise delete sync, multi-device merge, and optional end-to-end encryption. The Service offers Free, Plus, and Pro tiers that differ only in the bookmark limit — all other sync features are identical. See the Pricing page for details.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts
accounts.body: Using the Service requires registering an account with a valid email address. You are responsible for your account password and all activity under your account. Notify us immediately at support{'@'}bookmarksync.app if you suspect unauthorized access. Transferring or selling accounts is prohibited.

plans.title: 3. Tiers and subscription
plans.body: The Service offers Free (up to 500 bookmarks), Plus ($20/yr, up to 10,000 bookmarks), and Pro ($50/yr, unlimited bookmarks) tiers. All three share identical sync features; only the bookmark limit differs. Plus and Pro are yearly subscriptions that auto-renew and can be cancelled at any time — after cancelling you retain access until the end of the current billing period. All payments are processed by Creem (Armitage Labs OÜ, registered in Estonia) as Merchant of Record. Invoices are issued directly by Creem.

refund.title: 4. Refund policy
refund.body: Full unconditional refunds are available within 7 days of your first subscription. Beyond 7 days, partial or full refunds may be granted for severe technical failures that prevent core functionality. Refund requests must be sent to support{'@'}bookmarksync.app and will be answered within 3 business days. Refunds are returned to the original payment method. Abusive refund requests (e.g., requesting a refund immediately after subscribing while continuing to use paid features) will be declined.

acceptable.title: 5. Acceptable use
acceptable.body: You agree not to use the Service for any illegal or infringing activity, including but not limited to: storing illegal content, infringing others' intellectual property, uploading malicious code, attempting to reverse-engineer the Service, abusing quotas for large-scale automated data scraping, or interfering with Service operation. Violations may result in account suspension or termination without refund.

Bookmark data you store remains the intellectual property of you or the original rights holders; you grant us a non-exclusive, revocable license to store and transmit it as necessary to provide the sync service.

disclaimer.title: 7. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The Service is provided "as is" without guarantees of continuous availability, accuracy, or permanent data preservation. We are not liable for any direct or indirect losses caused by service interruptions, data loss, or cross-browser sync failures. You should periodically export important bookmarks as local backups. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is capped at the amount of your most recent payment.

termination.title: 8. Termination
termination.body: You may terminate your account at any time by uninstalling the extension and ceasing use. We may terminate accounts immediately for serious violations (e.g., intellectual property infringement, service abuse, payment fraud) and delete associated data. Paid amounts are non-refundable upon termination (except within the 7-day refund window).

Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the new Terms; if you disagree, stop using the Service. Pricing changes do not affect the rights of subscribers during their current billing period.
